content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"K-C applies because the judge is resolving a Matthew 1:20 collision between the challenger's and defender's own chain readings.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"The phrase 'weighs chain against chain by footing' — I weighed whether a bare note that both sides answered satisfies chain-by-footing, or whether it is a verse-level stalemate.","why":"The judge declared the Matthew 1:20 clash underdetermined by noting each side's answer but did not compare the chains' footing, so it leaves undone what K-C requires."}
